Case: Jesus is a 53-year-old who presents with 6 months of neck and arm pain with progressive gait difficulties. Jesus reports that he was in a car accident 6 months ago where he sustained some neck trauma, but he chose to leave the hospital against medical advice. Since then, he has had progressive neck pain with intermittent electrical-type pains involving his arms and sometimes his legs. Jesus also describes significant difficulty with balance and gait, for which he now uses a wheelchair to avoid falling.
